interpretation: The archive contains actual hardware regimes with both KV and replay superiority. July 5–10Gbps width-eight long contexts favor KV in 72/72 matched cases; September 10 uses an explicit 1Gbps aggregate proxy and its four matched-offered agentic cases favor replay. This is a network/endpoint/workload comparison, not evidence to force a QH ranking.

user_wire_anchor.private_fraction: Not established by archived measurements; do not apply another private-KV discount to the same user-measured effective bytes.
user_wire_anchor.distinction: The archived naive-serialization path uses 49,152 bytes/token and disables hybrid KV management. This does not disprove the user measurement on a different path or establish its private/full interpretation.

compact_hybrid_geometry_inference.scope: Numerically consistent with roughly 0.80GB, but not evidence that this is what the user measured or the archived serializer transferred.

policy-hardware-width8-frontier-20260730.scope: Actual distinct hardware policy episodes; pure actions matched by condition, episode, sample ID, match ID and all eight context counts. Commit endpoints independently equal maximum recorded per-session reaction commit. Requested 19/30s conditions are both retained; their 180s observation horizon is not a claimed 19/30s success.

policy-hardware-width8-packing-20260730.scope: Actual distinct hardware policy episodes; pure actions matched by condition, episode, sample ID, match ID and all eight context counts. Commit endpoints independently equal maximum recorded per-session reaction commit. Requested 19/30s conditions are both retained; their 180s observation horizon is not a claimed 19/30s success.

slo_loading.scope: Actual matched pure-policy runs; 10 repeats/load. Width falls above 0.875, so the highest loads are not width-eight comparisons. Offered load is a reference request-work rate, not GPU occupancy.

september_regional.scope: Actual regional hardware outcomes, but these pure-policy aggregates do not share identical context/placement/background cases. Regional component fitting uses 26 pure replay and 27 pure KV episodes; 24 heldout episodes check prediction. Effective application delivery includes software transport overhead; it is not backbone capacity or measured fleet-wide ingest.

september10_agentic.scope: Each seed/workload pair has identical frozen physical-workload and offered-trace hashes. Actual source snapshots, generated lengths and continuation work evolve and need not be identical. All endpoints are after the common 60s trigger; they include source export/quiescence and full generated validation work, not just prefill or wire. Destination-origin GET payload is separated from source-local GETs. No interpolation to a new bandwidth is performed.

notes: Initial replay uses full context; any batch with context>16384 uses the serial sum, then the measured regional factor. Changed-context catch-up rebuilds full context; no private-KV replay discount is applied.

The user 0.80GB anchor scales actual KV network bytes; native geometry still determines cache/block accounting. Retaining full-native effective application rates with fewer bytes favors KV rather than penalizing it.

Migration completion constants remain historical calibrated tails, not the entire 512-cap validation probe. The new server cadence prices source turns; observed 512-cap probe generation must be kept separate from prefill.
Shared 1000Gbps fleet WAN serves thousands of GPUs; it is a different per-GPU network-to-compute ratio from one-GPU 5/10Gbps hardware runs. Endpoint and shared caps must be checked jointly.

No unit/payload double-discount or hidden replay cache multiplier was identified in initial_work/catchup. Width/intermediate-load transfers, approximate fleet recovery and future placement remain conditional model assumptions.
